about: Hand-labelled excerpts for measuring the rule set. Labels say what a careful human reviewer would conclude about the sentence for that task: support, conflict, mention (about the task, no decision) or irrelevant (not about the task). All text is fictional. Labels were written before running scripts/evaluate-rules.mjs and were not changed to fit its output. Slice 3 relabelled one item to the shared convention before any rule change; see its 'relabelled' field.

issues.DREC-3: Raise the public API rate limit to 600 requests per minute

issues.DREC-7: Turn on single sign-on for the admin console
